versions.content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Os_11020 If the input parameter of IncrementCounter is valid, IncrementCounter shall increment the Counter < Counter ID> by one (if any alarm connected to this Counter expires, the given action, e.g. Task activation, is done) and shall return E_OK .
